abstract: Cytoreductive surgery increases the cure rate in selected patients with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumor receiving chemotherapy. Complete resection of residual malignancy is a prerequisite for improving long-term disease-free survival after chemotherapy. Complete resection of residual tumor after three to four inductions with an optimal chemotherapy regimen is the current recommendation. Progression of disease on chemotherapy represents a contraindication to cytoreductive surgery. Residual malignant tissue is found in up to one third of patients with clinical evidence of residual disease after chemotherapy and currently constitutes a current indication for further chemotherapy. Incomplete resection of malignant tissue and elevated tumor markers after surgery are poor prognostic signs. Elevated serum tumor marker levels after chemotherapy and prior to surgery represent a relative contra-indication to surgery, and such patients should receive additional chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 減量手術は、適切な化学療法を受けた進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の選択された患者において治癒率を高めます。化学療法後の長期無病生存の改善には、残存悪性腫瘍の完全切除が前提条件です。最適な化学療法レジメンを3～4回施行した後の残存腫瘍の完全切除が現在の推奨です。化学療法中に病勢進行がみられる場合、減量手術は禁忌となります。化学療法後に臨床的に残存病変が認められる患者の最大3分の1で残存悪性組織が認められ、現在はさらなる化学療法の適応となっています。術後の不完全切除および腫瘍マーカー高値は予後不良の徴候です。手術前の化学療法後に血清腫瘍マーカーが高値の場合は手術の相対的禁忌であり、そのような患者には追加の化学療法を行うべきです。
